description: This file defines a utility for converting hexadecimal color strings to SwiftUI Color objects. It contains a single enum 'ColorHexSupport' with a static method 'color(fromHex:)' that processes an optional string, trims whitespace, validates the format, and returns a corresponding Color if valid.

methods.name: color(fromHex:)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal color string to a SwiftUI Color object if valid, otherwise returns nil.
